neighbours.label: words for decorative handcrafts made from yarn, thread or folded paper (crochet, origami, macrame, knitting), usually firing inside the craft word
fire: On Sunday afternoons my grandmother would crochet little hats for the hospital.
The library runs a free origami class for beginners every month.
A macrame plant hanger was the first thing he ever made.
For the school fair, the pupils made origami frogs that could jump.
After retiring she took up crocheting and sold shawls at the market.
The shop sells patterns for crocheted toys and baby blankets.
Her hobbies include embroidery and macrame, mostly in the winter.
He learned the origami technique of wet folding from a book.
quiet: On Sunday afternoons my grandmother would cook little pies for the hospital.
The library runs a free chess class for beginners every month.
A wooden bird feeder was the first thing he ever made.
For the school fair, the pupils made clay frogs that could whistle.
After retiring she took up gardening and sold tomatoes at the market.
The shop sells recipes for homemade bread and fruit jams.
Her hobbies include swimming and chess, mostly in the winter.
He learned the swimming technique of bilateral breathing from a book.
